VBO:0201095.summary: Playful and affectionate, the Silver Pug shares the Pug’s lively, even-tempered companion character and strong interest in human company. Intelligence can go alongside a strong will in this sociable little dog. Its coat has a cool silver cast, contrasting with the dark mask and ears.
VBO:0201095.shortDescription: A playful, affectionate companion, the Silver Pug combines lively charm and a strong will beneath a cool silver coat.
